text_en: Then Job answered:
text_cn: 约伯回答说：

text_en: “How long will you torment me, and break me in pieces with words?
text_cn: 你们叫我的心悲伤，说话苦恼我，要到何时？

text_en: These ten times you have cast reproach upon me; are you not ashamed to wrong me?
text_cn: 你们侮辱我，已有十次之多，苛待我却不知羞愧。

text_en: And even if it is true that I have erred, my error remains with me.
text_cn: 我若实在错了，错自由我承当。

text_en: If indeed you magnify yourselves against me, and make my humiliation an argument against me,
text_cn: 如果你们真要对我自夸，证明我的丑恶，

text_en: know then that God has put me in the wrong, and closed his net around me.
text_cn: 你们应当知道：是天主虐待了我，是他用自己的罗网围困了我。

text_en: Even when I cry out, ‘Violence! ’ I am not answered; I call aloud, but there is no justice.
text_cn: 我若高呼说：“残暴”，但得不到答复；我大声呼冤，却没有正义。

text_en: He has walled up my way so that I cannot pass, and he has set darkness upon my paths.
text_cn: 他拦住我的去路，使我不得过去，使黑暗笼罩着我的去路。

text_en: He has stripped my glory from me, and taken the crown from my head.
text_cn: 他夺去了我的光荣，摘下了我头上的冠冕；

text_en: He breaks me down on every side, and I am gone, he has uprooted my hope like a tree.
text_cn: 他四面打击我，使我逝去；拔除我的希望，犹如拔树。

text_en: He has kindled his wrath against me, and counts me as his adversary.
text_cn: 他对我怒火如焚，拿我当作他的仇敌。

text_en: His troops come on together; they have thrown up siegeworks against me, and encamp around my tent.
text_cn: 他的军队一齐开来，修好道路攻击我，围着我的帐幕扎营。

text_en: “He has put my family far from me, and my acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
text_cn: 他使我的兄弟离弃我，使我的知己疏远我。

text_en: My relatives and my close friends have failed me;
text_cn: 邻人和相识者都不见了，寄居我家的人都忘了我。

text_en: the guests in my house have forgotten me; my serving girls count me as a stranger; I have become an alien in their eyes.
text_cn: 我的婢女拿我当作外人，视我如一陌生人。

text_en: I call to my servant, but he gives me no answer; I must myself plead with him.
text_cn: 我呼唤仆人，他不回答；我必须亲口央求他。

text_en: My breath is repulsive to my wife; I am loathsome to my own family.
text_cn: 我的气味使妻子憎厌，我的同胞视我作臭物。

text_en: Even young children despise me; when I rise, they talk against me.
text_cn: 连孩子们也轻慢我，我一起来，他们就凌辱我。

text_en: All my intimate friends abhor me, and those whom I loved have turned against me.
text_cn: 我的知交密友都憎恶我，我所爱的人也对我变了脸。

text_en: My bones cling to my skin and to my flesh, and I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
text_cn: 我的骨头紧贴着皮，我很侥幸还保留牙床。

text_en: Have pity on me, have pity on me, O you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me!
text_cn: 我的朋友，你们可怜可怜我罢！因为天主的手打伤了我。

text_en: Why do you, like God, pursue me, never satisfied with my flesh?
text_cn: 你们为何如同天主一样逼迫我，吃了我的肉还不知足呢？

text_en: “O that my words were written down! O that they were inscribed in a book!
text_cn: 惟愿我的话都记录下来，都刻在铜板上；

text_en: O that with an iron pen and with lead they were engraved on a rock forever!
text_cn: 用铁凿刻在铅版上，永远凿在磐石上。

text_en: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and that at the last he will stand upon the earth;
text_cn: 我确实知道为我伸冤者还活着，我的辩护人要在地上起立。

text_en: and after my skin has been thus destroyed, then in my flesh I shall see God,
text_cn: 我的皮肤虽由我身上脱落，但我仍要看见天主；

text_en: whom I shall see on my side, and my eyes shall behold, and not another. My heart faints within me!
text_cn: 要看见他站在我这一方，我亲眼要看见他，并非外人；我的五内因热望而耗尽。

text_en: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him! ’ and, ‘The root of the matter is found in him’;
text_cn: 如果你们说：“我们怎能难为他？怎能在他身上寻到这事的根由？”

text_en: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishment of the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment. ”
text_cn: 你们应当害怕刀剑，因为报复罪恶者是刀剑；如此你们知道终有一个审判者。
